plugins.name: spend-ledger
plugins.description: ZCode 用量与成本归因：从本地用量库为每次请求定价，把开销归因到工具、文件与 MCP 服务器，并拆解上下文成分。全程只读、离线、零依赖。

description_i18n.en: Token and cost attribution for ZCode: price every request from the local usage DB, attribute spend to tools, files and MCP servers, and break the context down into system prompt, tool schemas and history. Read-only, offline, zero runtime dependencies.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 用量与成本归因：从本地用量库为每次请求定价，把开销归因到工具、文件与 MCP 服务器，并把上下文拆成系统提示、工具 schema 与历史消息。全程只读、离线、零运行时依赖。
